  {"step":2,"file":"src-vul/fuzz_as.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":31,"var":"fakeArgv[1]","code":"fakeArgv[1] = filename;","note":"The temporary file path is passed as the assembler input filename."},
  {"step":3,"file":"src-vul/fuzz_as.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":39,"var":"perform_an_assembly_pass","code":"perform_an_assembly_pass (2, (char**)fakeArgv);","note":"The assembler is invoked on the attacker-controlled file, causing the parser to read the crafted contents."},
  {"step":4,"file":"src-vul/binutils-gdb/gas/read.c","function":"read_begin","line":null,"var":"notes_calloc","code":"notes_calloc = htab_create_alloc (...);","note":"During assembler initialization, read_begin allocates the notes hash table used for section notes processing."},
  {"step":5,"file":"src-vul/binutils-gdb/libiberty/hashtab.c","function":"htab_create_alloc","line":282,"var":"htab","code":"return htab_create_alloc (...);","note":"The hash-table constructor is called with a calloc-backed allocator for the notes table."},
  {"step":6,"file":"src-vul/binutils-gdb/libiberty/hashtab.c","function":"htab_create_alloc","line":null,"var":"size","code":"htab_create_alloc (size, hash_f, eq_f, del_f, alloc_f, free_f)","note":"The requested table size is zero or otherwise invalid for this regression, so the allocator path produces a null table pointer."},
  {"step":7,"file":"src-vul/binutils-gdb/gas/read.c","function":"read_begin","line":null,"var":"notes_calloc","code":"notes_calloc->...","note":"The null table is later dereferenced while initializing notes handling, triggering the ASAN null-dereference read."}
]
